# TaxNorth.ca

> Free AI-powered Canadian tax assistant for newcomers — in 12 languages. No account required.

TaxNorth.ca is operated by Ascendant Canada Ltd. (Alberta, Canada). It provides a free multilingual AI tax assistant and educational guides for newcomers to Canada. The service is educational only and does not constitute professional tax advice.

## About the Service

TaxNorth serves newcomers to Canada including permanent residents, international students, work permit holders, refugee claimants, and first-time filers. The AI assistant answers tax questions in 12 languages: English, French, Spanish, Mandarin, Arabic, Punjabi, Romanian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Dari/Farsi, and Turkish.

The service also connects users with verified licensed CPAs across Canada through a paid introduction ($19.99 one-time fee).

## Key Topics Covered

- How to file taxes in Canada as a newcomer (first-time filers)
- T4 slips and employment tax documents
- Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit (replaced GST/HST credit in July 2026)
- Canada Child Benefit (CCB) for newcomers
- Canada Workers Benefit eligibility
- RRSP and TFSA accounts for newcomers
- Tax filing deadlines (April 30 for most individuals, June 15 for self-employed)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) — how to get one as a newcomer
- Foreign income reporting for new residents
- CRA My Account setup for newcomers
- Refugee claimant taxes in Canada
- Moving expenses tax deduction in Canada
- Work permit holder tax obligations
- International student taxes in Canada
- Provincial tax differences across Canada
- Notice of Assessment — how to read yours
- Voluntary Disclosures Program for unfiled returns
- Business registration and self-employment taxes for newcomers
